primitives.name: Ownership Projection Accuracy

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic mapping between fantasy ownership prediction and market equilibrium deviation.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute error in projected ownership percentages.

primitives.name: QB Pressure Rate by Position
primitives.assumptions: Pressure rate is calculated based on snap-level tracking data from NextGenStats.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If pressure rate exceeds 15%, indicates high vulnerability at that OL position.

layer2.mapping: Kernel regression of OL positional pressure rates against quarterback performance indicators.
layer2.telemetry: Average QB sack rate per game adjusted for OL alignment.
